mapper.select: SELECT auth_token_id AS authTokenId, tenant_id AS tenantId, login_id AS loginAccountId, tenant_code AS tenantCode, auth_token AS authToken, token_type AS tokenType, expires_at AS expiresAt, used_at AS usedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_tenant_auth_token WHERE auth_token = #{value}

SELECT auth_token_id AS authTokenId, tenant_id AS tenantId, login_id AS loginAccountId, tenant_code AS tenantCode, auth_token AS authToken, token_type AS tokenType, expires_at AS expiresAt, used_at AS usedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_tenant_auth_token WHERE tenant_code = #{value} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tenant_auth_token SET expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_code = #{value} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
